en.title: Hybrid Joint Modeling
en.summary: Failure modeling for hybrid lap joints under tensile loading in LS-DYNA.
en.challenge: Single-lap aluminum–CFRP hybrid joints fail through interacting adhesive, interface, and structural mechanisms that are difficult to observe directly in tests.
contribution: Built and calibrated finite-element models for the hybrid lap-joint specimens.
Applied cohesive-zone behavior to represent adhesive initiation and progressive failure.
Automated result extraction and compared simulated force/displacement and failure patterns with experiments.
technical: HyperMesh defines joint geometry, mesh, contacts, and material/adhesive regions.
LS-DYNA solves tensile loading and progressive interface damage.
Python post-processing aligns simulation outputs with experimental curves and failure observations.

architecture.label: Experiment
architecture.detail: Specimen geometry, materials, boundary conditions, and tensile measurements define the reference.

architecture.label: FE model
architecture.detail: Metal, CFRP, adhesive, mesh, contacts, and cohesive parameters represent the joint.

architecture.label: Simulation
architecture.detail: LS-DYNA calculates load transfer and progressive damage under tensile loading.

architecture.label: Comparison
architecture.detail: Python aligns curves and failure modes to evaluate model credibility.

outcomes: Completed a thesis-level simulation and validation workflow with excellent academic evaluation.
Demonstrated understanding of composite/metal joining, nonlinear failure, and model calibration.
Built reusable Python analysis steps around commercial CAE outputs.

zh.title: 複合接頭建模
zh.summary: 在 LS-DYNA 進行拉伸載荷下的複合膠接件失效建模。
zh.challenge: 鋁合金與碳纖維複合材料單搭接接頭的失效，涉及膠層、介面與結構機制的交互作用，難以直接從實驗中完整觀察。
contribution: 建立並校準複合材料搭接試件的有限元素模型。
採用內聚區模型描述黏著層起始與漸進式失效。
自動化結果擷取，並比較模擬與實驗的力位移曲線及失效模式。
technical: HyperMesh 定義接頭幾何、網格、接觸與材料及膠層區域。
LS-DYNA 求解拉伸載荷與漸進式介面損傷。
Python 後處理將模擬輸出與實驗曲線及失效觀察結果對齊。

architecture.label: 實驗
architecture.detail: 試件幾何、材料、邊界條件與拉伸量測構成參考基準。

architecture.label: 有限元素模型
architecture.detail: 金屬、碳纖維複合材料、膠層、網格、接觸與內聚參數共同描述接頭。

architecture.label: 模擬
architecture.detail: LS-DYNA 計算拉伸載荷下的傳力與漸進式損傷。

architecture.label: 比較
architecture.detail: Python 對齊曲線與失效模式，以評估模型可信度。

outcomes: 完成論文等級的模擬與驗證流程，並獲得優異學術評價。
展現對複合材料與金屬接合、非線性失效及模型校準的理解。
圍繞商用 CAE 輸出建立可重用的 Python 分析步驟。
